title: Slums
prerequisites: Party created and Rolf's tour finished (New Phlan, ECL 0).
Commission #1 may be heard from the council clerk first, but [P] says the reward is paid even if it was never offered.
[P] assumes a new level-1 party of six with melee weapons, armor and shields bought and spells memorized at an inn.
XP figures assume exactly six characters.

scenarios.title: Enter the Slums from New Phlan
steps: From New Phlan walk west through exit E2 at (0,4).
The party is placed in the Slums at E1 (15,4).
While the block is not cleared the game prints 'YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MONSTER-CRAWLING SLUMS OF PHLAN. SMALL, UGLY THINGS SCURRY FROM BENEATH YOUR FEET. IN THE DISTANCE, AN ALARM SOUNDS.'
expect: Current area is the Slums (ECL 20), party position (15,4).
The entry text with the alarm is shown because the block is uncleared.
branches: Block already cleared: [P] says hearing 'an alarm' on entry means the block is not cleared yet, so a cleared block must not print the alarm sentence.
coveredBy: verifyFreshSlumsVictory (milestone 'Created six characters, completed Rolf's tour, saved and reloaded, and entered the Slums.')
scenarios.notes: The digest does not give the text shown on entering a cleared Slums; only that the alarm is the sign of an uncleared block. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (entry): one step west from (0,4) prints the entry text and puts the party in area 20 at (15,4) with no clear points; going back east returns to the New Phlan gate at (0,4), and entering again prints the text again. The script prints it on entry while its clear points (0x4abb) are below 254 (ECL2.DAX block 20 at 9aa9 to 9b24). The cleared-block branch is not exercised.

scenarios.title: Use the other Slums exits
steps: Leave the Slums by exit E2; the party arrives in Kuto's Well (ECL 29).
Walk to E3 at (6,10); the game prints 'YOU ARE JUST NORTH OF THE ENTRY TO THE OLD ROPE GUILD.'
Step into the guild; the game prints 'YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MYSTERIOUS BUILDING THAT WAS ONCE THE ROPE GUILD. MOST WHO VENTURE INTO ITS TWISTY HALLS NEVER RETURN.'
Press 'A' for the area map inside the guild; no automap is available.
expect: E1 returns to New Phlan, E2 leads to Kuto's Well, E3 (6,10) leads into the Old Rope Guild.
Inside the guild the area map is unavailable.
data: E2 -> Kuto's Well (coordinates not given in the digest)
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no coordinates for E2. Which of the two guild texts prints on which square is not stated; the order above follows the script order.

scenarios.title: Beat the orcs arguing over papers at location 1
steps: Walk to (13,1). The game prints 'SEVERAL ORCS ARE ARGUING OVER SOME PAPERS.'
Fight 1 ORC (#13) and 3 ORC (#4).
Win and take the treasure.
expect: Each of six characters gains 77 XP.
Treasure contains a Clerical Scroll with Cure Light Wounds twice.
One clear point is credited (set fight 1 of 9).
Resting in this room is now safe.
fights: 1 ORC (#13) + 3 ORC (#4), Morale 99, adjacent start, 77 XP per character (party of six)
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 1 'Several Orcs arguing over a piece of paper'
coveredBy: verifyArmoredPatrols (milestone 'Won three Slums patrols and the fixed orc outpost, then reloaded the fully rested party:')
verifyOhloArmor (milestone 'Won the Slums orc outpost fight and reloaded Enna with the earned XP and clerical scroll.')
scenarios.notes: XP figures in this file are per character for a party of exactly six. npm run acceptance:slums (orcs) fights this with the game's own commands and requires: the text; four combatants named ORC beside the six characters; a win; 77 experience points each; loot of exactly one 'Clerical Scroll With 2 Spells', which the cleric takes; one more clear point (script variable 0x4abb) and the fight marked as fought (0x4aca = 255); three whole days of rest in the room with no interruption; no second fight on walking back in; and the scroll's contents. The game names the scroll only by its number of spells. To see the spells the cleric must Ready the scroll, which takes both hands (the game's item table, file ITEMS, gives kind 62, the clerical scroll, two hands; manual p.9: 'An item that is not Ready cannot be used'): with mace and shield in hand Use answers 'Must be Readied' and Ready answers 'Your hands are full!', each on the bottom line for a moment. With both put away the scroll is readied and Use lists 'Spells on Scroll, 1st Level: Cure Light Wounds, Cure Light Wounds' with the menu 'Choose Spell: Cast Exit'; one casting leaves 'Clerical Scroll With 1 Spell'. The script's rule for the safe rest is: a rest is safe on any square that has an event of its own, once the block is not marked by the gypsy's murder (ECL2.DAX block 20 at 9a0e to 9a48).

scenarios.title: Beat the goblin armsmaster and his students at location 2
steps: Walk to (10,1). The game prints 'A HEALTHY-LOOKING GOBLIN IS INSTRUCTING A GROUP OF YOUNG WARRIORS. HE SMILES AND SAYS, 'I SEE OUR OPPONENTS HAVE ARRIVED.''
Fight 1 GOBLIN LEADER (#12) and 8 GOBLIN GUARD (#2).
Win and take the treasure.
expect: The fight is worth 545 XP, shared among the characters still standing when it ends: 90 each for six.
Treasure contains Leather Armor +1 (the game lists it as 'Leather Armor' until it is identified).
One clear point is credited.
fights: 1 GOBLIN LEADER (#12) + 8 GOBLIN GUARD (#2), Morale 60, 90 XP
coveredBy: verifyGoblinRoom (milestone 'Cleared the Slums goblin room and reloaded the salvaged gear:')
scenarios.notes: Clue Book says to cast Detect Magic on the goblins' items to find the treasure; the digest names only the Leather Armor +1. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage goblins). The party is the one the Lee guide tells a player to make (qa/research/party.md), loaded from qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan; fights are fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics (Sleep aimed clear of the party, then let the enemy come; a bandage for a friend who goes down), and the party recovers in each beaten room. It requires the text; the door north of (10,2) locked and bashed open; eight combatants named GOBLIN GUARD and one GOBLIN LEADER beside the six characters; a win; all six standing and 90 experience points each on the end screen; one more clear point (0x4abb) and the fight marked as fought (0x4acb = 255); exactly one plain 'Leather Armor' in the loot, which the thief takes. That suit is Leather Armor +1: the game names an unidentified item by its plain name, so the test swaps it for the leather armor the thief bought and requires his armor class to be one better (4 to 3). The total is 545, shared among the characters standing at the end and rounded down: the ready-made party of the test 'goblins' ends the same fight with three standing and 181 each, and in other runs on 2026-11-21 with five standing and 109 each; 545 is the one total that gives 181 for three, 109 for five and 90 for six. With the fixed dice of a replay the guide's party took 36 turns and 3 Sleeps, and one character lost 2 hit points.

scenarios.title: Do Ohlo's errand and give him the potion
steps: Walk to location 3 at (13,10). The game prints 'YOU BURST INTO AN ELEGANTLY PANELLED ROOM. A SMALL MAN SITS HUNCHED OVER A TABLE BY THE EAST WALL. HE SETS DOWN HIS PEN AND GAZES STERNLY AT YOU. 'WELL?', HE DEMANDS. (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu LEAVE / TALK / ATTACK.

Choose TALK and parley Nice or Meek. He says ''I MAY HAVE A USE FOR YOU,' THE MAN SAYS. 'SOME TIME AGO, I ORDERED A SPECIAL POTION. THE POTION IS READY BUT I CAN'T LEAVE TO FETCH IT. BRING IT HERE, I PAY WELL.'' with the menu ACCEPT THE COMMISSION / REJECT IT.
Choose ACCEPT THE COMMISSION. He says ''IT WAITS IN A BOOTH IN THE OLD ROPE GUILD BUT A SHORT DISTANCE TO THE SOUTHEAST FROM WHERE YOU NOW STAND. SPEAK MY NAME, OHLO.''
Walk to location 19 at (15,12). The game prints 'A MAN HURRIES FORWARD. 'I AM SORRY, NOBLE ONES, BUT I HAVE NOTHING TO SELL.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu LEAVE / ATTACK / SPEAK.
Choose SPEAK. At 'WHAT DO YOU SAY? (TYPE A SINGLE WORD)' type OHLO.
The game prints ''WAIT A MOMENT,' THE MAN SAYS. HE HURRIES TO THE BACK OF THE BOOTH AND RETURNS WITH A PACKAGE. 'HERE,' HE SAYS.' No item is added to any inventory.
Return to (13,10). Ohlo says ''YOU HAVE DONE WELL. GIVE ME THE POTION AND YOU WILL BE REWARDED.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu GIVE / ASK FOR MORE MONEY / REFUSE TO GIVE.
Choose GIVE. The game prints 'THE MAN TAKES THE POTION AND GULPS IT GREEDILY. AS YOU WATCH, HE SEEMS TO GROW YOUNGER AND STRONGER. 'EXCELLENT,' HE SMACKS, 'YOUR REWARD.''
expect: Reward: 1 jewelry, 150 platinum and 1 random magic item.
Each character gains between 558 and 891 XP depending on the random item.
The Ohlo clear point is credited (1 of the 25).
branches: REJECT IT at the offer: outcome not described in the digest.
Typing a word other than OHLO at the booth: ''I AM SORRY,' THE MAN SAYS, 'I CANNOT HELP YOU.''
Attack or insult Ohlo: see ohlo-attack-or-insult.
ASK FOR MORE MONEY or REFUSE TO GIVE: see ohlo-ask-for-more-or-refuse.
data: Reward 1 jewelry, 150 pp, 1 random magic item (558-891 XP)
disagreements: Object fetched: [P] 'a package (not an inventory item)'; Clue Book p.6 and Ohlo's own game text say 'a potion'; the merchant's game text says 'RETURNS WITH A PACKAGE'.
Reward: [P] '1 jewelry, 150 platinum, 1 random magic item'; Clue Book 'rewards you with a magic item'; [GB] 'experience, money, and 10 quarrels +1' (digest §7 item 6).
Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: Ohlo is 3, the potion booth is 15; [P]: Ohlo is 3, the merchant is 19.
coveredBy: milestone 'Walked to Ohlo, accepted his commission and verified the journal directions after reloading slot E.'
milestone 'Walked to the Rope Guild booth, picked up Ohlo's potion and verified the return objective after reloading slot H.'
milestone 'Returned the potion, collected Ohlo's reward and verified the journal and XP after reloading slot J.'
scenarios.notes: The game spells the Clue Book's 'Ohio' as OHLO (OCR noise in the Clue Book text layer). The random magic item makes the XP a range; with fixed dice a runner can pin the item. The game text has a booth line 'I AM SORRY, BUT I HAVE NOTHING TO SELL NOW. COME BACK SOME OTHER TIME.' (0xae3e) whose trigger the digest does not describe.

scenarios.title: Attack or insult Ohlo and fight his guard
steps: At (13,10) choose ATTACK, or TALK and parley Haughty or Abusive.
The game prints ''YOU PRESUME TOO MUCH,' THE MAN SAYS QUIETLY. HE GESTURES.'
Fight 1 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 2 ORC LEADER (#5), 8 ORC (#4) and 25 HOBGOBLIN (#6) starting at distance 1.
expect: Winning counts as dealing with Ohlo: the Ohlo clear point is credited ([P]: 'doing his quest or killing him').
fights: 1 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 2 ORC LEADER (#5), 8 ORC (#4), 25 HOBGOBLIN (#6); Morale 99; Distance 1; XP not given in the digest
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 3 'If you attack him, his army of monsters defend him'
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no XP or treasure for this fight.

scenarios.title: See Ohlo's other replies
steps: At (13,10) choose LEAVE; the game prints 'YOU GO BACK OUT THE DOOR.'
Find the parley result that prints ''I HAVE NO TIME FOR THE LIKES OF YOU,' THE MAN SAYS AIRILY. 'BEGONE!' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu STAY / LEAVE / ATTACK.
After accepting the errand, return to Ohlo without the potion; the game prints ''YOU HAVE RETURNED EMPTY HANDED,' HE OBSERVES. 'I HAVE NO TIME FOR YOU NOW.' HE WAVES HIS HAND.'
expect: Each text above is reachable and matches the game text exactly.
scenarios.notes: The digest maps only Haughty/Abusive (fight) and Nice/Meek (offer). It does not say which attitude gives the 'BEGONE!' reply (Sly is the one attitude left unmapped, but that is not stated), what STAY does, or what follows the empty-handed reply. A test author must read these from the script, not from the guides.

scenarios.title: Attack the Rope Guild merchant instead of speaking
steps: At location 19 (15,12) choose ATTACK.
Fight 15 HOBGOBLIN (#6) and 4 HOBGOBLIN LDR (#7).
After the fight the merchant is gone.
expect: The merchant no longer appears at (15,12).
The fight credits one clear point, unless Ohlo has already been dealt with.
fights: 15 HOBGOBLIN (#6) + 4 HOBGOBLIN LDR (#7), Morale 99; XP not given in the digest
disagreements: Composition: [P] 'Attacking the merchant instead -> 8 HOBGOBLIN (#6)'; the script of version 1.3 loads 15 of monster 6 and 4 of monster 7.
Credit: [P] says attacking the merchant 'still counts as dealing with Ohlo'; the script credits a clear point for the fight but leaves Ohlo's own flags as they were.
scenarios.notes: Game text 0xaf13 'THE MAN RUNS SCREAMING INTO THE BACK OF THE BOOTH.' sits next to the attack branch; the digest does not quote it. Read from the script, not played (ECL2.DAX block 20): ATTACK prints the 'RUNS SCREAMING' line (af13), then loads 15 of monster 6 and 4 of monster 7 at Morale 99 (af51 to af65; the same command loads the 1 + 15 kobolds of location 6 at a505), then sets 0x4a1d so the booth stays empty (af6d, tested at ae26) and credits one clear point unless 0x4a81 is already 255, which only Ohlo's reward or Ohlo's own fight sets (af73 to af7a). It does not set Ohlo's flags, so Ohlo can still be dealt with afterwards.

scenarios.title: Ask Ohlo for more money or refuse to give the potion
steps: Return to Ohlo with the package and choose ASK FOR MORE MONEY, or REFUSE TO GIVE.
Ohlo attacks.
expect: Combat starts instead of the reward.
No 1 jewelry / 150 pp / magic item reward is paid.
fights: Composition not stated for this branch in the digest; the attack/insult branch is 1 LEVEL 3 MU (#94), 2 ORC LEADER (#5), 8 ORC (#4), 25 HOBGOBLIN (#6), Morale 99, Distance 1
scenarios.notes: The digest says only 'he attacks'. It does not confirm the composition is the same as the insult fight.

scenarios.title: Search the stable at location 5 for the leather bag
steps: Enter the stable (location 5). The game prints 'YOU HAVE ENTERED A VERY UNCLEAN STABLE. THERE IS EVIDENCE THAT A LARGE AND UNTIDY ANIMAL HAD LIVED HERE.'
Search. The game prints 'YOU FIND A LONG LEATHER BAG. WILL YOU OPEN IT?' with YES / NO.
Choose YES.
expect: Treasure: 2 gems, 100 gold, 20 Arrows +1, Short Bow +1.
Each character gains 233 XP.
branches: NO: the bag is left; whether it can be found again is not stated.
data: 2 gems, 100 gold, 20 Arrows +1, Short Bow +1 (233 XP)
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 4 'Stable: Search the room to find the treasure'
disagreements: Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: stable is 4; [P]: stable is 5.
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no coordinates for the stable. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage stable). The party is the one the Lee guide tells a player to make (qa/research/party.md), loaded from qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan; fights are fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics (Sleep aimed clear of the party, then let the enemy come; a bandage for a friend who goes down), and the party recovers in each beaten room. The stable is the two squares (5,2) and (6,2); the test enters (6,2) from the room south of it, (6,3), whose own text is 'THE ROOM IS DIRTY AND HAS A STRONG AND UNPLEASANT ODOR.' The bag is found only when the square is entered with Search on (the script, ECL2.DAX block 20 at a461: COMPARE 0x6dca, 1), and only once (0x4acc). The test requires the stable's text and the bag's question in that order, YES, the screen 'The party has found Treasure! Each character receives 233 experience points.', a treasure of exactly 100 gold pieces and 2 gems when shared out, two items the game lists as '20 Arrows' and 'Short Bow' (unidentified magic carries its plain name; that they are +1 is not tested), and nothing on a second visit with Search on. A multi-classed character's sheet shows the award divided by the number of classes (116 of the 233 for a fighter/magic-user).

scenarios.title: Beat the feeding kobolds at location 6
steps: Walk to (7,0). The game prints 'YOU INTERRUPT SOME FEEDING KOBOLDS.'
Fight 1 KOBOLD LEADER (#11) and 15 KOBOLD (#0).
Win and take the treasure.
expect: Each character gains 289 XP.
The leader's Bracers AC 6 are in the treasure.
One clear point is credited.
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 5 'a set of magic bracers'
disagreements: Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: kobolds are 5; [P]: 6.
scenarios.notes: Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage kobolds). The party is the one the Lee guide tells a player to make (qa/research/party.md), loaded from qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan; fights are fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics (Sleep aimed clear of the party, then let the enemy come; a bandage for a friend who goes down), and the party recovers in each beaten room. The room is entered from (6,0) going east. The test requires the text; fifteen combatants named KOBOLD and one KOBOLD LEADER beside the six characters; a win; the guide's 289 experience points on the end screen (with fewer than six standing, the share of a total that gives 289 for six); one more clear point; and one pair of bracers in the loot, which the thief takes. They are Bracers AC 6: with his armor off and the bracers on, the thief's armor class is 2, 6 less the 4 his Dexterity of 19 gives.

scenarios.title: Overhear the rumours in the old hemp market (location 7)
steps: Walk through location 7. The game prints 'YOU WANDER IN THE OLD HEMP MARKET. MONSTERS SCURRY AT YOUR APPROACH. YOU OCCASSIONALLY CATCH SNATCHES OF CONVERSATIONS.'

One of three lines follows: '... THE GANG IS OPERATING FROM THE CATACOMBS BY THE WELL...', '... THE TEMPLE OVER THE RIVER IS RUN BY SOME HOT-SHOT ORC...', '... THERE IS A SECRET TREASURE ROOM IN THE NW CORNER ...'.
Clear the block, then walk through location 7 again.
expect: All three rumour lines can be seen before the block is cleared.
After the block is cleared the rumours stop.
data: Three rumours as quoted (game spelling 'OCCASSIONALLY' kept)
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no coordinates for location 7 and does not say how a rumour is chosen (random or in order).

scenarios.title: Pay the gypsy for a fortune at location 8
steps: Walk to (3,5). The game prints 'SEATED AT A TABLE IS A RAGGED OLD WOMAN. SHE GREETS YOU. 'WELCOME. FOR THE PRICE OF A FEW COPPERS, I WILL TELL YOUR FORTUNE.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu ATTACK / LEAVE / PAY.
Choose PAY. The game prints 'THE WOMAN'S HANDS MAKE MYSTIC PASSAGES WHILE SHE MUTTERS SOME WORDS. HER VOICE UNDERGOES A STRANGE TRANSFORMATION ...'
One fortune is shown, chosen by game progress.
The game prints 'THE TELLING IS FINISHED. (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu ATTACK / LEAVE.
Choose LEAVE; the game prints 'YOU LEAVE THE SHOP.'
expect: Fortune 1: 'BLOOD AND VIOLENCE ARE WRIT BOLDLY IN YOUR FUTURE. LOOK FOR FRIENDS WHERE YOU EXPECT ENEMIES AND ENEMIES WHERE YOU EXPECT ALLIES.'
Fortune 2: 'A POWERFUL ONE BECOMES AWARE OF YOUR DEEDS AND SEEKS TO DESTROY YOU. A WEAK ONE SEES YOU AS A PATH TO POWER.'
Fortune 3: 'THE TIME IS NIGH WHEN THE PATHS YOU HAVE TROD WILL EMPTY AND YOU MUST SEEK NEW WAYS. THE RIDDLE'S ANSWER IS GREAT EVIL USING GREAT GOOD FOR GREAT EVIL.'
The gypsy stays alive and random encounters keep their normal odds and size.
coveredBy: milestone 'Verified the ${outcome} fortune only appears after its reading and survives reload in the correct slot.' (--slums-fortune-checkpoint)
scenarios.notes: [P] says the fortune is 'chosen by game progress' but the digest does not give the thresholds. The price in coppers is not stated either. A test author must read both from the script.

scenarios.title: Attack the gypsy
steps: At (3,5) choose ATTACK.
The game prints 'YOU EASILY MURDER THE OLD WOMAN. EXCEPT FOR A FEW COPPER PIECES YOU FIND NOTHING OF VALUE. THE GODS HAVE NOTED YOUR ACTIONS.' No combat screen appears.
Check the party's money, then walk the block and rest.
expect: The party gains 3 copper.
The gypsy is dead for the rest of the game.
Random encounter chance rises by 5/14 outside the Rope Guild and 3/11 inside it.
Random encounter size rises by +5 or +10.
Resting in the Slums is never safe again, even in beaten rooms or after the block is cleared.
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 8 'it will enrage the monsters In the slums and make the random encounters much tougher'
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say what decides between +5 and +10 monsters.

scenarios.title: Beat the orcs at location 9
steps: Walk to (3,3). The game prints 'A LARGE ORC RAISES HIS HEAD AND SNARLS, 'HOW DARE YOU BREAK INTO OUR HOME?''
Fight 1 ORC LEADER (#15), 3 ORC LEADER (#14) and 16 ORC (#4).
Win and take the treasure.
expect: Each character gains 412 XP.
Treasure: 3 Broad Swords +1, Chain Mail +1, Flail +1.
One clear point is credited.
fights: 1 ORC LEADER (#15), 3 ORC LEADER (#14), 16 ORC (#4), Morale 70, 412 XP
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 9 'Cast detect magic on the orc's items'
scenarios.notes:
The pairing of the 0xa9a5 line with location 9 follows script order (it sits between the gypsy and the hobgoblins); the digest quotes no text for location 9. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage orchome), from qa/fixtures/guide-party-slums-first-training: the guide's party after the cleric's first training, five of six still level 1. The home's two squares, (2,3) and (3,3), have one door, the locked one north of (3,4); the party rests in the stable and bashes it. The test requires the text (0xa9a5, confirmed by play: it prints on entering (3,3)); sixteen combatants named ORC and four named ORC LEADER beside the six characters (the script asks for 20 of monster 4 at a9fa; the fight holds the guide's 16); a win by the guide's tactics; the guide's 412 experience points (with fewer than six standing, the share of a total that gives 412 for six); one more clear point and the script's own mark (0x4acd). On 2026-11-21 the fight took 89 turns and five Sleeps and ended with two of six standing, 1238 experience points each (2476 shared by two; 412 for six): AELAR, CAELUM, DORIAN and FINN were down Unconscious at the end, none dead (the test does not record who struck them; the loot shows four long bows); cures and rest in the beaten room put all six right. The loot is 3 'Broad Sword', 4 'Chain Mail' (one from each leader), 4 'Long Bow', '7 Arrows' and 1 'Flail'. One of the four suits is Chain Mail +1: worn in turn by the same character, three give one armor class and the fourth a class one better. The swords and the flail are taken; that they are +1 is not shown by this test (the game names unidentified magic by its plain name).
 The suits were tried by the cleric, who wears the hobgoblins' Ring of Protection +1: with the ring off her armor class in the four suits was 0, 0, 0 and -1; with it on, -1 in all four, as [P] says of the order of armor class ('Ring of Protection (only if no magic armor)').

scenarios.title: Beat the hobgoblins at location 10 and search for their gold
steps: Walk to (0,2). The game prints 'SOME HOBGOBLINS ARE ARGUING OVER A PILE OF GOLD. 'THIEVES!' THEY SCREAM WHEN THEY SEE YOU.'
Fight 5 HOBGOBLIN (#6).
After winning, search the room. The game prints 'YOU FIND A LARGE NUMBER OF VALUABLES.'
Take the treasure.
expect: Treasure: 50 platinum, 500 gold, Ring of Protection +1, Short Bow +1.
Each character gains 258 XP.
One clear point is credited.
data: 50 pp, 500 gold, Ring of Protection +1, Short Bow +1 (258 XP)
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 7 'Hobgoblins: Search the room after the combat to find their treasure'
disagreements: Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: hobgoblins are 7; [P]: 10.
scenarios.notes: The digest gives one figure (258 XP) for the location; it does not split fight XP from treasure XP. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage hobgoblins). The party is the one the Lee guide tells a player to make (qa/research/party.md), loaded from qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan; fights are fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics (Sleep aimed clear of the party, then let the enemy come; a bandage for a friend who goes down), and the party recovers in each beaten room. The room is entered from (0,1) going south. The test requires the text; five combatants named HOBGOBLIN; a win; one more clear point. The fight itself gave 22 experience points each on 2026-11-21, which the guide does not list. The 258 experience points are the treasure's, not the fight's: after the fight the party leaves north, turns Search on and comes back, the game prints 'YOU FIND A LARGE NUMBER OF VALUABLES.' and then 'The party has found Treasure! Each character receives 258 experience points.' (the script, aa8c to aacf: the room entered with Search on after the fight). The treasure is exactly 500 gold and 50 platinum pieces when shared out, and two items, a ring and a 'Short Bow'. The ring is a Ring of Protection +1: on the cleric's hand her armor class is one better.

scenarios.title: Find and loot the secret room at location 12
steps: Reach (0,0) in the north-west corner. The game prints 'YOU HAVE STUMBLED INTO A TREASURE ROOM.'
Search and take the treasure.
expect: Treasure: 2 jewelry, 4 gems, 50 platinum, 92 gold, 1000 electrum, 20 Arrows +1, Short Bow +1.
Each character gains 1173 XP.
data: 2 jewelry, 4 gems, 50 pp, 92 gold, 1000 electrum, 20 Arrows +1, Short Bow +1 (1173 XP)
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 6 'Secret Treasure Room: Treasure Is behind the illusionary wall to the east'
Hemp market rumour '... THERE IS A SECRET TREASURE ROOM IN THE NW CORNER ...' (game text ECL2.DAX block 20 at 0xa60c (src/audio/voice-master-manifest.json))
disagreements: Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: secret treasure room is 6, reached through an illusionary wall 'to the east'; [P]: location 12 at (0,0), 'Secret room; search'.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say how the room is entered. The game text 'YOU HAVE ENTERED A SMALL STORAGE ROOM.' (0xaae4) directly precedes the treasure-room line and is probably the room next to it (digest location 11 is not described); this pairing is an inference from script order. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage secret). The party is the one the Lee guide tells a player to make (qa/research/party.md), loaded from qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan; fights are fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics (Sleep aimed clear of the party, then let the enemy come; a bandage for a friend who goes down), and the party recovers in each beaten room. The room is entered by walking west from (1,0): the guide's map draws an illusionary wall there and the game lets the party through. (1,0) is reached from the lane at y=2 by going north through (2,1) and (2,0). The script hands out the treasure on entry, with no Search (ab0d to ab42), and only once (0x4ad6). The test requires the text, the screen 'The party has found Treasure! Each character receives 1173 experience points.', a treasure of exactly 2 jewelry, 4 gems, 50 platinum, 92 gold and 1000 electrum when shared out, two items the game lists as '20 Arrows' and 'Short Bow', and nothing on a second visit. The storage room (location 11) is (3,1), a different room, and is not visited.

scenarios.title: Beat the orc guards at location 13
steps: Walk to (0,7).
Fight 2 ORC LEADER (#5) and 30 ORC (#4).
Win.

One clear point is credited.

scenarios.notes: The digest quotes no text for location 13. Game text 0xab59 'GUARDS RUN TO INTERCEPT YOU.' is the likely line (script order: it sits between the treasure room and the monster leaders, and the Clue Book calls the spot 'Monster Guards'); confirm against the script before asserting it. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (guide, stage guards), with the guide's party (five of six level 1), fights fought with the game's own commands by the guide's tactics. The guards' three squares, (0,5) to (0,7), share one event; the party comes from the orcs' home across the old hemp market and bashes the locked door north of (0,8). The test requires the text 'GUARDS RUN TO INTERCEPT YOU.' on entering (0,7) (0xab59: confirmed by play); thirty combatants named ORC and two named ORC LEADER beside the six characters (the script asks for 4 of monster 5 at ab89; the fight holds the guide's 2); a win; the guide's 99 experience points (with fewer than six standing, the share of a total that gives 99 for six); one more clear point and the script's own mark (0x4acf). On 2026-11-22 the fight took 108 turns and five Sleeps and ended with four of six standing, 148 experience points each (99 for six); AELAR and CAELUM were down Unconscious, none dead, and cures and rest on the guards' square put all six right.

scenarios.title: Beat the trolls and ogres at location 20
steps: Walk to (0,14). The game prints 'SOME MONSTERS ARE TOSSING A SACK OF GRAIN. WHEN THE SACK BREAKS THEY WAIL, 'OH, NO! WHAT CAN WE THROW NOW?' ONE LOOKS YOUR WAY. 'I KNOW,' HE SAYS.'
Fight 4 TROLL (#31) and 2 OGRE (#8). The two ogres stand in front of the four trolls.
Win and take the treasure.
expect: Each character gains between 1222 and 2222 XP depending on the three random magic items.
Treasure: 1 jewelry, 50 platinum, 40 gold and 3 random magic items.
One clear point is credited.
branches: [P] tactic: cast Bless, Sleep both ogres so their bodies block the trolls, kill the front troll and stand on its body, shoot the rear trolls without focusing one.
Clue Book tactic: hold the ogres with the two best-armoured characters and kill them last; stand on a fallen troll's square so it cannot get up.
data: 1 jewelry, 50 pp, 40 gold, 3 random magic items
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 16 'Trolls and Ogres Tossing Things'
disagreements: Loot: [P] '3 random magic items'; [GB] 'ranseur +2, light crossbow +1, MU scroll (lightning bolt, detect invisibility, protection from evil)', one random outcome (digest §7 item 7).
Sleep on ogres: [P] says to Sleep both ogres; the Clue Book says to engage them in melee and never mentions Sleep.
Clue Book p.5-6 numbers the Slums map differently from [P]; the two numberings do not line up (see notes). Clue Book: trolls and ogres are 16; [P]: 20.
scenarios.notes: Troll rule to observe ([P] §5): a troll stays down only if all damage dealt to it was fire or acid, and regeneration starts 3 minutes after damage; a character standing on its square stops it rising (Clue Book). Random items follow the v1.3 generator ([P] §9.4).

scenarios.title: Flee the trolls and still get the clear point

Flee the combat with the whole party.
Read the clear-point counter.

The same holds for the other Slums set fights ([P] §5: 'set fights credit victory even if you fled').

scenarios.title: Re-roll the troll room's magic items by reloading

scenarios.title: Random encounters: exactly 15, with stated odds, sizes and types
steps: Walk the Slums outside the Rope Guild with search mode off; each step rolls 1 in 14 for an encounter.
Turn search mode on; the chance per step is 5 in 14 (1/14 + 4/14).
Walk inside the Rope Guild; the chance is 2 in 11, or 4 in 11 in search mode.
Count the monsters: Party Strength x 2/3 outside the guild, Party Strength inside.
Fight until 15 random encounters are beaten, then keep walking.
expect: The monster type is KOBOLD (#0), GOBLIN GUARD (#2) or ORC (#4) with equal odds.
Kobolds: 3 KOBOLD LEADER are added when the count is 8 or more. Goblins: 4 GOBLIN LEADER at 8 or more. Orcs: 4 ORC LEADER at 14 or more.
At a count of 19 or more a BUGBEAR (#63) leads and the text reads 'A BUGBEAR LEADING A PARTY OF ...'.
After the 15th random fight no further random encounter occurs when walking.
With the gypsy dead the chance gains +5/14 (outside) or +3/11 (inside) and the size gains +5 or +10.
data: 1/14 (+4/14 search, +5/14 gypsy dead) outside; 2/11 (+2/11 search, +3/11 gypsy dead) inside
Size PS x 2/3 outside, PS inside
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 location 14 and Finale
coveredBy: verifyOpeningReload (milestone 'Won the kobold encounter and verified Alda's 5 XP and 11 copper after reloading slot D.')
scenarios.notes: With fixed dice a runner can assert, per step, whether an encounter fires and its type and count. The digest does not say whether leaders count toward the monster total or replace ordinary monsters, nor whether 'at >=8' refers to the count before leaders.

scenarios.title: Random encounters: the four surprise outcomes
steps: Trigger a random encounter with neither side surprised and choose Wait.
Trigger one where only the party is surprised.
Trigger one where only the monsters are surprised and choose Wait.
Trigger one where both are surprised and choose Wait.
expect: Neither surprised: 50% the monsters are 'angry' (Morale 60; Wait or Parley leads to combat), 50% 'seedy-looking' (Morale 40; Wait makes them flee).
Party surprised only: the game prints 'YOU ARE SURPRISED BY ...' and they attack at Morale 70.
Monsters surprised only: Wait makes them flee (Morale 30). 'YOU HIDE.' (game text 0xb21a) belongs to this family of outcomes.
Both surprised: the text begins 'You bump into' and Wait makes them flee (Morale 50).
data: Morale 60 angry, 40 seedy-looking, 70 party surprised, 30 monsters surprised, 50 both surprised
scenarios.notes: The four ENCOUNTER MENU events (0x9cc5-0x9dde) have no captured text in the manifest, so the exact 'angry', 'seedy-looking' and 'You bump into' sentences are quoted from the digest in mixed case, not from the game text. [P] §5 says ECL opcodes 22 and 23 (surprise) apply the wrong modifiers; a faithful port keeps that. Which trigger prints 'YOU HIDE.' is not stated in the digest.

scenarios.title: Random encounters: parley score and thresholds
steps: In a random encounter choose Parley and an attitude.
The game prints 'YOU ARE CONVERSING WITH A PARTY OF ...' (or 'A BUGBEAR LEADING A PARTY OF ...').
The score is base + 1d31 + the speaker's Charisma reaction modifier, with the base from the table in data. (The script adds a base of 10, 20 or 30 and a draw from 0 to 30, which is the same thing.)
expect: Score 64 or less: the monsters attack with +20 Morale. The game prints 'YOU HAVE ANGERED THE <monsters> THEY ATTACK.'
Score 65-74: they attack, with the same text and no Morale bonus.
Score 75-85: the bribe demand (see parley-bribe-demand).
Score 86-95: the order to leave (see parley-ordered-to-leave).
Score 96 or more: the textile-house advice (see parley-textile-house-advice).
data: Base, 8 or fewer monsters: Haughty 9, Sly 19, Nice 19, Meek 19, Abusive 29
Base, 9-15 monsters: Haughty 4, Sly 14, Nice 14, Meek 9, Abusive 24
Base, 16 or more monsters: Haughty -1, Sly 9, Nice 9, Meek -1, Abusive 14
disagreements: Band edges: the digest gives '<=65' for the attack with +20 Morale and '65-74' for the plain attack, so a score of exactly 65 is in both.
scenarios.notes: The script settles the band edges (ECL2.DAX block 20): a score below 75 goes to 'YOU HAVE ANGERED THE' (b2f8), and below 65 the Morale gains 20 (b67d), so exactly 65 is the plain attack; 75 to 85 is the bribe demand (b303), 86 to 95 the order to leave (b4c1), 96 or more the advice. The score is the attitude's base, plus a draw from 31 numbers (0 to 30, b2de), plus script variable 0x6dcf, which the Parlay command leaves (the Charisma modifier by the digest; its size was not read from the program). The bases are 10/20/20/20/30 for 8 or fewer monsters, 5/15/15/10/25 for 9 to 15 and 0/10/10/0/15 for 16 or more, in the order Haughty, Sly, Nice, Meek, Abusive (b2a1, b2be, b2d0): one more than the table in data, with a draw that starts at 0 where the digest's 1d31 starts at 1. Read from the script only; no parley has been played.

scenarios.title: Parley result 75-85: pay, surrender, run or fight
steps: Reach a parley score of 75-85. The game prints 'THE MONSTERS RESPOND, 'DA BOSS DON'T LIKE YOUSE GUYS. GIVE US SUMPTIN AN MAYBE WE'LL FERGET WE SEEN YAS.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu PAY / SURRENDER / RUN / FIGHT.
PAY: the game prints 'TYPE IN THE NUMBER OF GP YOU OFFER.' Enter an amount.
expect: PAY with gold at least equal to the encounter's strength: 'THEY PAW THROUGH YOUR COINS AND LEAVE.' and the party loses half of its remaining money.
PAY with less: ''WHAT A BUNCH OF CHEAPSKATES,' THE LEADER COMPLAINS. 'LET 'EM HAVE IT BOYS!'' and combat starts.
SURRENDER: 'THE MONSTERS ROB AND BLINDFOLD YOU. YOU ARE KICKED SOUNDLY AND SENT ON YOUR WAY.' The party loses all money and light items plus some heavy ones.
RUN: the party flees to a flee square. FIGHT: combat.
sources: [P] §5 Exploit 7 theft protection; ECL opcode 28 (ROB) item-chance bug (digest)
scenarios.notes: The digest does not define 'the encounter's strength' numerically, nor which heavy items are lost. [P] §5: opcode 28 (ROB) handles the item chance incorrectly while iterating, and putting the heaviest items at the top of the inventory reduces theft; a faithful port keeps both. The digest does not say whether paying, surrendering or running counts toward the 15.

scenarios.title: Parley result 86-95: leave or be run in
steps: Reach a parley score of 86-95. The game prints 'THE LEADER SPEAKS, 'THE BOSS DON'T ALLOW YOUR KIND IN HIS TERRITORY. LEAVE NOW OR WE'LL HAVE TO RUN YOU IN.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu FIGHT / STAY / LEAVE / RUN.
expect: FIGHT or STAY: combat.
LEAVE or RUN: always succeeds; no combat.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say where LEAVE puts the party (same square or a flee square).

scenarios.title: Parley result 96+: advice about the textile house
steps: Reach a parley score of 96 or more. The game prints ''LET ME GIVE YOU A PIECE OF ADVICE,' THEIR LEADER SAYS. 'STAY AWAY FROM THE TEXTILE HOUSE. THE UNDEAD ARE GOING CRAZY UP THERE.' THE MONSTERS TURN TO LEAVE. (WHAT DO YOU DO?)' with the menu LET THEM GO / STOP THEM.
expect: LET THEM GO: the monsters leave without combat.
STOP THEM: the game prints ''HOW DARE YOU INTERFERE WITH THE BOSS'S BUSINESS?' THE LEADER ROARS. 'KILL THEM,' HE ORDERS.' and combat starts.
scenarios.notes: The digest names the two options but not their outcomes; the STOP THEM outcome is taken from the adjacent game text and should be confirmed in the script.

scenarios.title: Fleeing puts the party on one of five squares
steps: Flee from an encounter or a combat in the Slums.
Read the party position.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not give the odds of each square or whether it depends on where the party fled from. Established by npm run acceptance:slums (flee) and the script. A flight draws the party's facing from four numbers and then the square from five, each square equally likely and whatever square the party fled from (ECL2.DAX block 20 at b225 and b22b); the squares come from the tables at b6f2 (x: 15, 14, 11, 11, 9) and b6f7 (y: 4, 6, 5, 2, 2), the scenario's five in this order. The test flees random encounters with Search on and requires the party to stand on the table's square for the number the dice trace shows, facing the way drawn. The square is then entered like any other step (b24c), so an encounter can meet the party on arrival. Only an encounter that waits for the party's choice can be fled: when the monsters run first the game prints 'The monsters flee.' and the party stays. Fleeing out of a fight in progress is not exercised; the script sends a fled fight to the same routine (b118: result above 128 goes to b225).

scenarios.title: Rest rules in the Slums
steps: Rest in a room whose set encounter has been beaten; the rest is never interrupted.
Rest elsewhere in the uncleared block; each 2 hours rolls a 24% chance of interruption.
Clear the block and rest anywhere; no interruption.
Kill the gypsy and rest in a beaten room or in the cleared block; interruptions can occur.
expect: Safe rest: in a beaten set-encounter room, or anywhere once the block is cleared.
Unsafe rest: 24% per 2 hours.
With the gypsy dead no rest is ever safe.
sources: Clue Book p.5-6 'Where You Can Rest'
disagreements: Clue Book p.5 says only 'You can rest safely in any room where you have defeated a set encounter ... also ... after you have cleared the slums'; it does not mention the gypsy exception that [P] gives.
coveredBy: verifyArmoredPatrols (milestone '... then reloaded the fully rested party:')
scenarios.notes: The script's rule (ECL2.DAX block 20 at 9a0e to 9a48): with the gypsy murdered (0x4a0b = 255) a rest is never safe; otherwise it is safe once the block is cleared (0x4abb at 254 or more) and on any square that has an event of its own, and unsafe on every other square. Unsafe stores 24 in the two rest variables. A room's square can only be camped on once its fight is over, which is the Clue Book's and [P]'s 'beaten room'. npm run acceptance:slums (orcs) rests three whole days in the beaten room at (13,1) undisturbed; the harness self-test is interrupted by monsters within one rest of eight hours at (15,4).

scenarios.title: Rest interruptions keep giving clear points
steps: Beat all 15 random encounters.
Rest in an unsafe spot until a rest is interrupted by monsters.
Win the fight and read the clear-point counter.
expect: A rest-interrupt fight credits a clear point even when no random encounters remain.
By repeating this the block can reach 25 clear points without beating every set fight (the [P] alternative to fighting the trolls).
scenarios.notes: Faithful-port behaviour. The digest does not give the composition of a rest-interrupt encounter.

scenarios.title: Clear the Slums and collect commission #1
steps: Beat 15 random encounters.
Beat the nine set fights at locations 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 13, 14, 15 and 20.
Deal with Ohlo (finish his errand, kill him, or attack the merchant).
Leave by E1 and re-enter: the entry text no longer mentions an alarm.
In New Phlan go to the council clerk at City Hall 29 (5,5). She prints 'YOUR CLEARING OF THE SLUM AREAS PERMITS US TO EXPAND.' then 'HERE IS YOUR REWARD.'
expect: Clear points reach 25 (15 + 9 + 1).
Reward: 1 jewelry, 50 platinum, 250 gold; each character gains 450 XP.
Quest tracker advances by one (commission #1 is one of the ten tracker quests).
Resting anywhere in the Slums is safe (unless the gypsy is dead).
Any city-guard anger is cancelled by the reward.
branches: The commission need not have been offered first: 'In most cases, you do not actually need to be told of the mission to perform and be rewarded for it.'
data: Proclamation LIX (Adventurer's Journal p.13-15: clear any block)
sources: game text ECL3.DAX block 8 at 0xa8b6 (src/audio/voice-master-manifest.json) (offer: 'THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.')
disagreements: Clear condition: [P] '25 points (15 random + 9 set + Ohlo)'; Clue Book '15 random encounters and dealt with all the set encounters'; [SP] 'mapped this block completely, and have had 15 random encounters' (digest §7 item 8).
scenarios.notes: No existing replay asserts the Slums reward at the clerk (verifyFreshSlumsVictory covers the opening and a first victory, not the clear). 450 XP = (2200 + 50x5 + 250) / 6. Because of the quirks above, 25 points can also be reached by rest interruptions or by fleeing set fights. The script settles the clear condition (ECL2.DAX block 20): one routine (b69c) adds a clear point and stores 254, the cleared mark, when the count reaches 25. It is called after each of the nine set fights (9e73, 9f08, a514, aa02, aa87, ab91, abfe, ac4b, b10d), after Ohlo's reward and after Ohlo's own fight (a3b2, a0be), after the merchant's fight (af7a), and after every random fight the party wins, whether met on a walk or in a rest (b134, b14f). Mapping plays no part. Walking stops rolling for encounters once 15 random fights are beaten (9b32), so 15 + 9 + 1 is the ordinary way to 25, but any 25 credits clear the block. npm run acceptance:slums (orcs) sees the count go up by exactly one for the fight at location 1.
